layout.release/openconfig/models: 56 files: arista-*-augments.yang + arista-*-deviations.yang across 23 feature dirs (OpenConfig surface only)
layout.openconfig/public/release/models: vendored upstream OpenConfig snapshot (129 device-advertised modules resolve here)
layout.experimental/eos/models: 123 files / ~101 device-advertised arista-* modules — NOT release-supported; must not enter authoritative catalogue by default

notes: unmatched ietf-*/iana-if-type resolve via bonsai's ietf-yang source, not this repo
openconfig-hercules-* are Arista cloud-platform models absent from this snapshot
arista-segmentation.v1 / arista-sensor-client-sysdb-types / synth-dev-mod-* are device-internal or versioned names

conclusions: release/openconfig is the correct supported closure: arista augment+deviation modules for the OpenConfig surface; upstream OpenConfig models come from bonsai's separate openconfig-public pin (revision compatibility must be verified at compile time — augments do not pin import revisions)
experimental/eos must NOT be imported into the authoritative catalogue by default (101 advertised modules live there — device-advertised != release-supported)
pathreport.csv is versioned vendor documentation suitable as advisory provenance only; it is NOT device-effective authority (no YANG Library on EOS)
cEOS has no RFC8525/legacy YANG Library -> schema-bound applicability stays fail-closed; only explicit selective acquisition can proceed, bounded and admin-approved
